title: Agreement of a closed locally planar set with a 2-plane near one unit point propagates along the whole great circle
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let S ⊆ ℝ^P be a closed set such that every p ∈ S with p ≠ 0 has δ > 0 and a 2-dimensional linear subspace Q' of ℝ^P with S ∩ B_δ(p) = Q' ∩ B_δ(p). Let Q be a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P, and suppose some x₀ ∈ Q with |x₀| = 1 and some ε₀ > 0 satisfy S ∩ B_ε₀(x₀) = Q ∩ B_ε₀(x₀). Then every x ∈ Q with |x| = 1 has some ε > 0 with S ∩ B_ε(x) = Q ∩ B_ε(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x₀ : Euclid P) (ε₀ : ℝ), IsClosed S → (∀ p ∈ S, p ≠ 0 → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (Q' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < δ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q' = 2 ∧ S ∩ ball p δ = (Q' : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p δ) → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → x₀ ∈ Q → ‖x₀‖ = 1 → 0 < ε₀ → S ∩ ball x₀ ε₀ = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x₀ ε₀ → ∀ x : Euclid P, x ∈ Q → ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ S ∩ ball x ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε
